items.title: Noctule Release “Goddess Of Rot” Inspired By Elden Ring’s Malenia
items.summary: Noctule have released “Goddess Of Rot,” a new track inspired by Elden Ring character Malenia and written by Serena Cherry.
items.content:
Noctule , the video game-inspired metal project led by former Svalbard vocalist/guitarist Serena Cherry , have unveiled a new single inspired by one of the most formidable characters in Elden Ring .

Dubbed “ Goddess Of Rot ,” the track serves as Cherry ’s musical tribute to Malenia , one of the bosses featured in FromSoftware’s acclaimed action RPG. The song will appear on Noctule ’s upcoming sophomore album, ‘ Extinguish Thy Flame ,’ which focuses entirely on the bosses and characters of the Elden Ring universe.

For Cherry , Malenia’s tragic story provided the foundation for what is notably one of the slower and more atmospheric tracks on the new record. She explained:

“Honestly? I think this is the solo song that Svalbard fans will appreciate the most. It has the big reverb-drenched leads, the pretty-yet-sad harmonies, a balance of emotional screams and delicate clean singing. It’s the slowest and least heavy song on the album, leaning into atmospheric Finnish Metal influences such as Insomnium and Sentenced, but also DSBM influences such as Thy Light.”

She went on to explain how Malenia’s story of sacrifice and loss shaped the song, particularly the character’s attempts to protect her brother Miquella while being consumed by Scarlet Rot.

“But what does the music mean? Well, in the fight to protect those you love, you can get destroyed beyond recognition. When love morphs into sacrifice that leads to inevitable loss. This is what my new song ‘Goddess of Rot’ is about – but specifically, it is about Malenia.”

“Malenia is one of the bleakest characters in the harsh game of ‘Elden Ring.’ So of course, she is my favourite. She is fighting to protect her brother Miquella while slowly losing herself to Scarlet Rot.”

The musician also said she connected deeply with Malenia’s story of abandonment and wanted the song to reflect the destructive nature of Scarlet Rot.

“I deeply connected with her tragic story, so I wrote a song about Malenia to encapsulate the abandonment she suffers but also pay sonic tribute to the devastating power of her Scarlet Rot.”

‘ Extinguish Thy Flame ’ is scheduled for release on September 25th .

items.title: Elden Ring met "Tarkov" - and something went wrong. Mistfall Hunter Review
items.summary: In recent years, many extraction games have entered the market. However, truly mass-market projects in the genre are almost non-existent. After the release of Marathon, the genre's potential seems exhausted. The idea of cloning "Tarkov" has long ceased to work. Developers have to find their own formula for success, experimenting with mechanics and other genres. Mistfall Hunter is one example of such hybridization.
items.content:
0 Источник: Bellring Games 14 August 2026, 17:30 Daniil Shepard In recent years, many extraction games have entered the market. However, truly mass-market projects in the genre are almost non-existent. After the release of Marathon, the genre's potential seems exhausted. The idea of cloning "Tarkov" has long ceased to work. Developers have to find their own formula for success, experimenting with mechanics and other genres. Mistfall Hunter is one example of such hybridization.

The game is based on familiar elements: dodges, parries, precise stamina management, character classes, and battles with strong opponents. On top of this, the developers built a raid system familiar to the genre, with loot loss upon death, searching for valuable equipment, and evacuation from the map.

At first glance, such a combination looks interesting. However, after a few hours, it becomes clear that the mechanics of different genres do not complement each other but regularly conflict. Class balance quickly reduces variety to a few most effective builds, map features limit exploration freedom, and some game decisions create additional inconvenience rather than deepening the gameplay.

The first thing a player encounters in Mistfall Hunter is technical problems related to Unreal Engine 5. These issues accompanied the game during playtests and were not resolved by release. Performance remains unstable even on modern configurations. Frame drops occur both in the starting camp and in raids, and shader compilation does not solve the problem of periodic location loading and freezes. In battles against other players and bosses, such stutters can cost a victory.

The network component also raises many questions. Russian users still experience difficulties connecting to servers, despite developers' promises to solve the problem during the testing phase. The game is officially available for purchase in the Russian Steam region, but playing without third-party applications is not possible.

At the same time, the server performance itself cannot be called decent. Players regularly encounter problems with hit registration and incorrect display of other players' positions in raids. Shots sometimes pass through opponents without registering damage, and melee attacks can reach the target even before characters visually close the distance. In this regard, the game is very similar to the online component of FromSoftware projects, where similar problems also occur.

But the greatest indignation among the audience was caused by how the developers decided to eliminate these problems. Instead of optimizing the network architecture and renting high-quality servers, the developers held a promotion in conjunction with a service to accelerate game traffic. During the release, players were given temporary free access to its functions. The problems did not go away, and the promotion ended long ago.

The core gameplay of Mistfall Hunter is built around mechanics from Souls series games. The player chooses a class, goes on raids, and fights ordinary enemies, bosses, and other players. The combat system is based on dodges, parries, distance control, and skillful use of abilities. In PvE, this formula works confidently, but in PvP, the same problems appear as in the original games of the genre.

At release, six classes are available in the game: two warriors, two mages, an archer, and a rogue. The choice is wide, but in practice, each of them lacks the variety expected from a developed build system. Against ordinary enemies and bosses, any class performs its functions calmly, but in battles between players, the effectiveness of characters varies greatly.

Mages and archers are currently the most effective. They regularly appear in ranked selections and community discussions, and complaints about their dominance have become one of the most frequent topics in user reviews. Archers have skills with automatic aim assist, and mage attacks, in turn, have wide hitboxes. Because of this, a timely dodge does not always allow avoiding damage, especially if the caster aims at the feet or strikes preemptively.

Melee classes are at a disadvantage. To deal damage, they need to close the distance, and doing so against mobile ranged characters is not easy. Each of them has abilities that allow them to quickly close the distance or gain a few extra seconds. But most often, by the time a warrior reaches the target, they take a significant portion of the damage even before the full engagement begins.

The dodge system deserves special attention. Unlike most soulslike games, a special bar is allocated for dodges, designed for only a few consecutive dashes. It is not possible to constantly jump around the field, so each dodge must be used against a specific attack. This limitation makes battles more measured and forces players to pay closer attention to the opponent's actions.

The stun mechanic is also interestingly implemented. Many attacks briefly deprive the target of the ability to act, allowing for a series of blows. However, it is impossible to endlessly keep the opponent in this state. After two stunning hits, the dash bar instantly recovers, and the player gets the opportunity to retreat urgently. Thanks to this, melee combat requires not only good reactions but also skillful use of one's arsenal. Simply repeating the same technique turns out to be less effective than alternating different strikes.

But such depth is preserved mainly in solo raids. In team play, most of these nuances quickly lose their significance. The most effective tactic becomes a simultaneous attack by the entire group on one target. Under such pressure, defensive mechanics practically cease to work, and the outcome of most clashes is determined by which squad loses a player first. As a result, a significant part of interesting mechanics remains in demand only in duels.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Receives Pre-Release Trailer
Before Elden Ring launches on Switch 2 this month beat Lies of P first
items.summary: No word of a lie, it's worth your time.
items.content:
Lies of P is out now on the Nintendo Switch 2 and it deserves its flowers. Elden Ring will be great, but this is the souls game to play.

Nintendo Switch 2 owners are counting down the days until Elden Ring finally launches on the console.

It’s been many months in the making as the Elden Ring port was delayed from 2025 to this year, but will finally launch on August 28.

Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition will include the full game, plus DLC, and some new cosmetics/starter classes, which will be available as paid content packs for other platforms.

Before embarking on another quest to become Elden Lord though, consider a different souls game you can play right now on your Nintendo Switch 2, Lies of P . We’d even argue it’s better than Elden Ring in some regards.

After launching in September 2023, Lies of P has acquired quite a large fanbase, but it’s nowhere near as popular as FromSoftware’s work. Hopefully, the recently released Nintendo Switch 2 port will see it garner some new supporters, and you should be one of them.

Lies of P: Complete Edition , much like Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition , is the full game plus the DLC expansion Overture .

Combined, that’s over 55 hours of gameplay according to HowLongToBeat , if you plan on doing side-content.

My own playthroughs on the Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5 ran flawlessly and I was delighted to see the Nintendo Switch 2 version be just as good.

It felt like there was little to no sacrifice in terms of performance or visual quality despite being on Nintendo’s hardware. It just felt like good ol’ Lies of P, but this time I could take it on the go.

Bloodborne fans will get a kick out of it instantly because it’s a game that rewards a bolder playstyle. After taking damage, you can replenish a bit of your health by striking your opponent, so trading blows becomes a high-risk, high-reward strategy for melting bosses.

Lies of P will give you just as much of a challenge as some of FromSoftware’s work, and I’d argue that the Overture expansion is actually harder at times. However, if you’d rather just experience the story, past updates added difficulty modes that’ll make life a bit easier.

Elden Ring remains one of my favourite games and while I’m excited to play it on the Nintendo Switch 2 later this month, Lies of P’s re-release got me more excited.

As good as Elden Ring is, I’ve always felt its scale to have diminishing returns on repeat playthroughs. Unless I’m feeling committed, riding around the map to collect items I want for my build starts to feel like I’m shopping rather than playing a game.

items.title: FromSoftware Attempted Ray Tracing with Elden Ring, But It Pales in Comparison to Dark Souls 3 with Modded Path Tracing
items.summary: Modder Ganaboy is bringing path tracing to Dark Souls 3 via the DS Lighting Engine, delivering stunning visuals.
items.content:
Although FromSoftware has created some of the best action RPGs of all time, never ceding to the pressure to create more marketable titles , the Japanese studio is not exactly known for pushing the technical boundaries of games. In Elden Ring , the studio led by Hidetaka Miyazaki did try its hand at ray tracing with ray-traced ambient occlusion and shadows, but what it has achieved pales in comparison to the modded path tracing that is coming soon to Dark Souls 3 .

The third entry in the series is getting remastered lighting thanks to modder Ganaboy , who is working on a new version of the DS Lighting Engine mod, which added path tracing to Dark Souls 2 back in April. Although a release date for the new version of the mod has yet to be confirmed, its developer released two work-in-progress videos showcasing the High Wall of Lothric and the Firelink Shrine in path-traced glory.

In addition to sharing the videos above, Ganaboy also shared the system requirements to enjoy Dark Souls 3 with path tracing when it launches. "DS3 Geometry is 10X of DS2, Requirements will be similar to DS2LE, All cards supported for DS2LE will be for DS3 as well. All RTX 2/3 series are supported. You may have to use a slightly higher upscaling. For eg if you used Quality mode in DS2LE. You will probably need to use Balanced for DS3," the modder wrote in the video's description.

Considering how path tracing is generally extremely demanding even in dated games , it's no surprise that upscaling via NVIDIA DLSS will be required to achieve an acceptable level of performance.

With FromSoftware's incredible art direction, Dark Souls 3 with path tracing truly looks stunning, even with some of its current issues, including some sequences that are a little too dark. Hopefully, FromSoftware itself won't wait too long to start implementing path tracing natively in its games, as I believe it would do wonders for enhancing the incredible atmosphere the Japanese developer injects into its hardcore action RPGs.

items.title: Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2
items.summary: Pre-order available. Explore a breathtaking world full of excitement and mystery.
items.content:
08/11/26 Pre-order now Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2 The Lands Between—a place of myth, gods, and broken dreams. Long ago, Queen Marika and her divine offspring reigned here, but since the Elden Ring was shattered, the world has fallen into decay. Now, the land whispers for a King.

The “Tarnished,” long exiled, are finally seeing the light of Grace once more. Step into this hauntingly beautiful realm, unravel its ancient mysteries, and rise as the one true Elden Lord.

The ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition game arrives on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system on August 28 .

The Lands Between are part of a vast continent, where magnificent open fields and huge dungeons with complex three-dimensional designs are seamlessly connected. As you explore, the joy of discovering unknown and overwhelming threats awaits you.

Mastery of the terrain and knowledge of its secrets can help you overcome enemies and defeat formidable bosses—or lead invading players into traps.

The founding mythology of Elden Ring was written by George R. R. Martin and adapted into a rich multilayered story. Intersecting goals and desires between the characters create an intense narrative that weaves throughout the Lands Between. The events of the game can unravel in many ways—depending on your interventions.

Combat is simple to learn yet offers hidden depths of dexterity. As you seek to become the Elden Lord, you’ll need to explore the balance between attacking, avoiding damage, using a wide variety of weapons, spells, summons, and perfecting your timing to take advantage of your opponents’ weaknesses.

In addition to customizing the appearance of your character, there are countless ways to combine the weapons, armor, usable items, and magic that you equip. You can develop your character according to your play style.

No matter if you prefer bold physical confrontation, tactical spellcasting, or the subtle art of stealth, you’ll be able to find gear that supports your choices.

Traverse together with other Nintendo Switch 2 players. You can play with up to two other Tarnished as your cooperative teammates, either by inviting them using a shared password or by summoning them from a pool of nearby community members.

There are also ample opportunities to face off against other players, either through co-op invasions, invited duels, or the many player battle options available in the three Colosseums.

If you’d like to learn more or begin your journey to the Lands Between by pre-ordering the Tarnished Edition, please check out the link below.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition arrives August 28, with a new Story Spotlight video available now
items.summary: The path to the Elden Throne awaits, on Switch 2
items.content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment has released a new Story Spotlight video for Elden Ring Tarnished Edition, ahead of the game's August 28 launch on Nintendo Switch 2. The video sets the stage through the fractured Lands Between, a broken world where the faint call of grace still lingers among the ruins, and the path to the Elden Throne awaits those bold enough to walk it.

Elden Ring Tarnished Edition brings the acclaimed FromSoftware and Bandai Namco open-world action RPG to Nintendo hardware for the first time, giving you the chance to step into the Lands Between and the Realm of Shadow with more than 400 "Game of the Year" nominations behind it. The package includes the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion as well.

Tarnished Edition also introduces a slate of new content, including two new Starting Classes, brand-new character armor, and the ability to customize Torrent, the player's in-game mount. The new content will also be available for purchase for Elden Ring on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam.

For more news on Elden Ring, stay tuned to GamingTrend!

One of the first big releases to capture the hearts of fans was the ambitious RPG, Crimson Desert , hailing from developer Pearl Abyss. Following not long after Crimson Desert was the new James Bond game from IO Interactive, 007 First Light , which sold over three million copies during its first few weeks after launch. More recently, Assassin’s Creed fans have been enjoying the Resynced version of Black Flag , which is widely hailed as one of the best Assassin’s Creed games ever made. Closing out 2026 are a pair of massive releases, Marvel’s Wolverine from Insomniac and Grand Theft Auto 6 from Rockstar Games .

There have been plenty of popular games to emerge in the last 5–10 years, but few have been as successful as Elden Ring , the ambitious effort developed by FromSoftware. Not only did Elden Ring handily win Game of the Year at the 2023 Game Awards, but it’s also getting a live-action adaptation courtesy of A24 from writer/director Alex Garland . The new drops from Elden Ring aren’t stopping anytime soon, either, as the Figure Fetch website recently confirmed the release of a new 1/4-sized Malenia statue later this year. Now available for pre-order, the new Malenia statue retails for $250, and those who pre-order now can expect it to ship out later this year in December. The new figure is a must-have for Elden Ring collectors, especially those select few who managed to conquer Malenia during their Elden Ring playthrough.

items.content:
Who is the Raging Wolf?

Among the first Tarnished to join the Roundtable Hold was Vargram, a warrior of great skill and ferocity. He acquired the title of the Raging Wolf from the white wolf pelt that flowed from his helm. Vargram sought to become the shadow of one of the Empyreans and built his strength relentlessly as he traveled through fallow Limgrave to the golden city of Leyndell. And yet in spite of all his strength, his armor is now worn by another… An unnamed Tarnished now walks the Lands Between in the skin of the wolf. Does this warrior seek the same fate as Vargram, forever stalking at the side of an Empyrean? Will they uphold the Golden Order or supplant it for some new code? Whatever the destination, woe befall upon any who dare block the path.

The most impressive Elden Ring statue yet

Standing at 33 cm/13 inches, it’s one of the largest character statues ever produced for ELDEN RING. Crafted with the attentive supervision of FromSoftware, this full 1/6 scale figure captures each minute detail with masterful skill. The size allows perfect fidelity to the beautiful and dark fantasy atmosphere of the game, including smears of bloody red across blade of the Bastard Sword and the crest of the Iron Roundshield. From the intricate filigrees of its helm to its whisps of silvered fur blown back by an errant breeze to the humble, dusty cloth wraps protecting the feet of its greaves against the mossy stones of the path to Stoneveil Castle, it’s a portrait of the implacable will of the Tarnished. All these expertly rendered touches from sculpturer Shinya Yamaoka make this statue a perfect match to the most iconic set from one of the most iconic games of this generation.

Where can I get a Raging Wolf Set statue?

Pre-orders for the Raging Wolf 1/6 scale statue can be placed on the official Bandai Namco website. At this time, based on the production estimates of Gecco studio, these stunning PVC/ABS figures will ship to your home in Winter of 2026. If you are a true aficionado of the game, there is no better purchase to bring the world of Elden Ring to your home or office. It’s a timeless piece for your own collection or an impressive gift for a friend or loved one. And one small note, if you have not yet found this set in the Lands Between for your Tarnished, we recommend you seek the aid of Recusant Bernahl at the Volcano Manor.

Place your order for the Raging Wolf statue on the official Bandai Namco Store.

*This product is available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.

items.content:
Follow in the foosteps of Miquella once more with this exclusive 2 disc vinyl collection, celebrating the sweeping, emotional journey of Shadow of the Erdtree.

Presented with the reverence merited by a legendary expansion, this premium set is crafted for collectors, audiophiles, and Tarnished who seek to experience the Realm of Shadow through its music.

The Collection

Housed in a full color gatefold sleeve and marked with the symbol of Messmer the Impaler, each vinyl disc is pressed on heavyweight material to ensure optimal durability and warmth of playback. Whether displayed proudly on a shelf or played to relive your own quest, this set is designed as both a collector’s piece and a lasting tribute to one of the most celebrated expansions in modern gaming.

The Artists

Across 18 tracks, the soundtrack transforms the ELDEN RING experience into a powerful standalone odyssey—one carried by orchestral grandeur, ethereal choir work, and the signature melancholy that defines the worlds created by FromSoftware.

A Collector’s Treasure

This official vinyl set is an essential centerpiece for any discerning fan’s collection. Perfect for longtime followers of FromSoftware’s musical legacy or newcomers drawn into the Land of Shadow for the first time. *This vinyl is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, Middle East, India and the United States

items.title: Discover the ELDEN RING Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp
items.summary: Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING ’s most iconic character. Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique n
items.content:
Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING’s most iconic character.

Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique night lamp captures the tragic loyalty and silent strength of Blaidd, Shadow of Ranni.

The lamp features an LED-illuminated base that reveals glowing rune symbols beneath Blaidd’s feet, evoking the grace-given power that guides Tarnished across the Lands Between. Rising above it, an engraved acrylic summoning panel glows softly when lit, capturing the look and feel of an in-game summon sign and the spirit-calling magic it represents. Powered through a simple USB connection, it offers effortless illumination for any desk, gaming setup, or collector’s display.

"If ever thou shouldst call upon me… I shall come."

Blaidd’s oath echoes still. Now, he stands ready, not for battle, but as a silent guardian of your space.

Bring the moonlit magic of ELDEN RING into your world, one glowing rune at a time.

*This edition is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia and the United States.
